claims.text: The reporting period included a total of 1024 canonical cases.
Among these, 1023 cases were classified as serious.

The most frequently reported reactions were Acute kidney injury (80 cases, 7.8%), Drug ineffective (54 cases, 5.3%), Hypotension (46 cases, 4.5%), Drug interaction (43 cases, 4.2%) and Dyspnoea (38 cases, 3.7%).
Temporal analysis identified observed windows with case counts of 109, 21, 61, 60, 59, 57 and 57 cases.

Analytical limitations include the absence of SOC-level analysis, inability to determine expectedness, lack of history‑of‑actions data, and that the dataset does not establish causality between bisoprolol and reported reactions.
